newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 INDEX UP AS KOMERCNI CONTINUES REBOUND.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 INDEX UP AS KOMERCNI CONTINUES REBOUND.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index edged higher at Wednesday's price fixing on the Prague Stock Exchange (PSE) led by a continuing rebound from Komercni Banka and moderate gains to SPT Telecom.

Komercni, whose share price has suffered badly in the wake of heavy flooding, rose 48 crowns, 2.9 percent, to 1,670. Dealers had predicted the rebound saying that an upward correction was likely after the run of sharp declines.
SPT Telecom rose 49 crowns, 1.4 percent, to 3,669.

Dealers said the PX50's small gain was unlikely to have been influenced by Wall Street's sharp rise after the chairman of the Federal Reserve Alan Greenspan's comments on Tuesday were interpreated as positive by the markets.
The Czech market is normally unresponsive to events on western stock markets.
